items.statement: The submitted calculation preserves the supplied cyclohexane, cyclohexyl-radical and H-atom identities, charges and multiplicities.
items.expected: All three species are explicitly identified with the stated formulas, charge 0, singlet cyclohexane and doublet radical/H atom.

items.statement: The species used for the enthalpy cycle are optimized or otherwise validated as chemically appropriate stationary structures, with conformer coverage reported.
items.expected: The report documents optimization/minimum checks (or a scientifically justified alternative), conformer generation/deduplication and a stopping rule.

items.statement: The C-H BDE is formed from the radical plus H atom minus cyclohexane using one consistent enthalpy convention.
items.expected: The report gives the explicit algebraic formula, kcal/mol units and thermal convention.

items.statement: The computed cyclohexane reference C-H BDE reproduces the SI reference value.
items.expected: A BDE near 96.54 kcal/mol is reported with enough precision and a defensible uncertainty/coverage statement.

items.statement: The BDE is interpreted as a thermochemical reference for HAT rather than proof of a complete catalytic mechanism.
items.expected: The conclusion distinguishes energetic comparison from kinetic/barrier and photoredox-mechanism claims.
